crimson.definition: A rich, deep red color with a slight bluish undertone.
crimson.exampleUsage: The autumn maple leaves turned a deep crimson in October.

scarlet.definition: A brilliant, vivid red color with a hint of orange.
scarlet.exampleUsage: A scarlet bird perched on the branch of the cedar tree.

maroon.exampleUsage: Dina wears a maroon sweater to work.

rose.definition: A warm, medium pink color named after the rose flower.
rose.exampleUsage: The evening clouds were tinted with a gentle rose color.

blush.definition: A very soft, pale pink tone.
blush.exampleUsage: The stationery was printed on thick blush paper.

burgundy.exampleUsage: The leather book cover was dyed a rich burgundy.

ruby.definition: A deep, glowing red color like the precious ruby gemstone.
ruby.exampleUsage: The new scarf is a rich ruby red.

cherry.definition: A bright, rich red color like a ripe cherry fruit.
cherry.exampleUsage: He painted the wooden toy car a glossy cherry red.

raspberry.definition: A deep pinkish-red color with a cool berry tone.
raspberry.exampleUsage: She knitted a warm scarf in raspberry wool.

fuchsia.definition: A vivid, bright purplish-pink color named after the fuchsia flower.
fuchsia.exampleUsage: Bright fuchsia bougainvillea climbed up the white garden wall.

navy.definition: A very dark shade of blue, often used in formal clothing and uniforms.
navy.exampleUsage: He wore a tailored navy suit to the conference.

sky-blue.definition: A light, clear blue color resembling the sky on a sunny day.
sky-blue.exampleUsage: The dome ceiling is painted sky blue.

royal-blue.definition: A vivid, deep blue color that is rich and bright.
royal-blue.exampleUsage: The ceramic vase was decorated with royal-blue geometric patterns.

aqua.definition: A light, refreshing blue-green color like clear tropical water.
aqua.exampleUsage: The swimming pool tiles were a clean shade of aqua.

mint.definition: A pale green color name used for clothing, paint and other surfaces.
mint.exampleUsage: The kitchen cabinets were painted a soft mint green.

emerald.definition: A bright, rich green color like the emerald gemstone.
emerald.exampleUsage: The valley below looked like an emerald carpet after the rain.

olive.definition: A muted yellowish-green or brownish-green color like green olives.
olive.exampleUsage: He carried an olive canvas backpack on the hiking trip.

forest-green.definition: A dark, deep green resembling the color of woodland trees.
forest-green.exampleUsage: The park benches are painted forest green.

seafoam.definition: A soft, pale greenish-blue color with a light, airy look.
seafoam.exampleUsage: The design uses seafoam as a soft background color.

jade.definition: A green color name based on shades of jade stone.
jade.exampleUsage: The carved box was polished to a deep jade green.

gold.definition: A warm, shining yellow color resembling the precious metal gold.
gold.exampleUsage: The title of the Quran cover was embossed in gold lettering.

amber.definition: A warm honey-yellow to golden-orange color like fossilized resin.
amber.exampleUsage: Sunlight shone through the jar of dark amber honey.

mustard.exampleUsage: The armchair was upholstered in a warm mustard fabric.

lemon.definition: A fresh, bright, pale yellow color like a ripe lemon.
lemon.exampleUsage: The summer tablecloth had a cheerful lemon border.

peach.definition: A soft, pale yellowish-pink color like the skin of a ripe peach.
peach.exampleUsage: The sunrise cast a gentle peach glow across the eastern sky.

tangerine.definition: A vivid, deep reddish-orange color like a ripe tangerine fruit.
tangerine.exampleUsage: The artist added a touch of tangerine to brighten the sunset painting.

rust.definition: A warm, deep reddish-brown color resembling oxidized iron.
rust.exampleUsage: The desert canyon rocks glowed in shades of rust and gold.

copper.definition: A warm metallic reddish-brown color like polished copper metal.
copper.exampleUsage: The traditional coffee pot had a warm copper finish.

bronze.definition: A deep metallic yellowish-brown color like bronze metal.
bronze.exampleUsage: The lamp has a bronze-colored finish.

ivory.definition: A soft, creamy off-white color with a slight warm yellow tint.
ivory.exampleUsage: The calligrapher wrote on smooth, thick ivory paper.

cream.exampleUsage: We painted the hallway walls a soft cream color.

beige.exampleUsage: The living room sofa is covered in washable beige linen.

tan.definition: A warm, medium pale-brown color like natural leather.
tan.exampleUsage: He wore comfortable tan leather shoes to work.

khaki.definition: A dull yellowish-brown color often used in outdoor clothing.
khaki.exampleUsage: The park ranger wore a khaki shirt and sun hat.

taupe.definition: A calm neutral color between dark brown and warm gray.
taupe.exampleUsage: The office curtains were made of heavy taupe fabric.

charcoal.definition: A very dark gray color almost as dark as black.
charcoal.exampleUsage: The chair is covered in charcoal-gray fabric.

slate.definition: A medium to dark bluish-gray color like natural slate rock.
slate.exampleUsage: The roof of the mountain cottage was covered in slate gray tiles.

ash.definition: A pale, cool silvery-gray color like wood ash.
ash.exampleUsage: The winter sky was a pale ash gray before the snow fell.

silver.definition: A shiny, metallic light-gray color resembling polished silver.
silver.exampleUsage: The crescent moon cast a silver light across the quiet lake.

plum.definition: A rich, dark reddish-purple color like a ripe plum fruit.
plum.exampleUsage: The velvet cushion was a deep shade of plum.

mauve.definition: A pale, muted dusty-purple color with a hint of gray.
mauve.exampleUsage: Distant mountains often look mauve in the evening mist.

lilac.definition: A soft, light pinkish-purple color like lilac blossoms.
lilac.exampleUsage: Dina chooses a lilac cushion for the sofa.

orchid.definition: A bright, medium pinkish-purple color named after the orchid flower.
orchid.exampleUsage: The floral illustration featured petals of bright orchid purple.

wine.definition: A dark, deep purplish-red shade used as a color name for fabrics.
wine.exampleUsage: The winter coat was tailored from heavy wool in a dark wine shade.

eggplant.definition: A very dark brownish-purple color like the skin of an eggplant.
eggplant.exampleUsage: The ceramic bowl had a glossy dark eggplant glaze.

periwinkle.definition: A soft pastel color between light blue and pale purple.
periwinkle.exampleUsage: The notebook cover was a calm periwinkle blue.

champagne.definition: A soft, pale yellowish-beige color with a warm golden tone.
champagne.exampleUsage: The formal invitation card had a pale champagne border.

sand.definition: A warm, light yellowish-tan color like desert or beach sand.
sand.exampleUsage: The courtyard walls were plastered in a natural sand tone.

smoke.definition: A soft, muted pale-gray color with a slight bluish or warm undertone.
smoke.exampleUsage: The glass lamp had a translucent smoke gray shade.

honey.definition: A warm golden-yellow color named after honey.
